name: Juice Dollar
oneLiner: JUSD is Juice Dollar's decentralized dollar on Citrea, minted from oracle-free overcollateralized BTC positions using a Frankencoin/d-EURO architecture.
collateral: Wrapped cBTC (WCBTC, the Citrea Bitcoin L2 native-coin wrapper) deposited in oracle-free overcollateralized positions, plus StablecoinBridge routes that mint JUSD 1:1 against external Citrea stablecoins USDC.e, USDT.e and ctUSD (Citrea USD); protocol is a d-EURO / Frankencoin (ZCHF) architecture fork.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting against BTC collateral on Citrea with automated on-chain liquidations when collateral ratios fall below required thresholds; no external price oracles; positions and debt are verifiable on-chain (Frankencoin-style design)

oracleRisk.summary: JuiceDollar docs describe JUSD as an over-collateralized stablecoin with no oracles, so collateral accounting is protocol-internal.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Juice Dollar contracts are documented as immutable with no admin keys, so no direct JUSD holder freeze was identified. Active USDC/USDT bridge routes deposit source stablecoins and mint JUSD 1:1, creating upstream freeze exposure.

reserves.name: BTC collateral in oracle-free overcollateralized positions on Citrea

mintAuthority.summary: JUSD is an ownerless Frankencoin fork on Citrea. owner() reverts; no EIP-1967 proxy admin; mint() reverts NotMinter() (0xf8d2906c) for unapproved callers, confirming minting is gated to registered minter modules only. JUICE pool-share holders can veto new minters during the application period.

controls.label: JUSD Frankencoin-style minter registry
controls.capDescription: JUSD is minted only by registered positions/minter modules that survive the application/veto period; positions mint against overcollateralized BTC on Citrea with oracle-free on-chain liquidations. The token has no owner and contracts are immutable.
controls.evidence: At Citrea block 8542294: owner() reverts (no Ownable); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = zero (no proxy); implementation slot = zero (not proxied); mint(0x1111...,10) reverts custom error NotMinter() (0xf8d2906c, confirmed via openchain.xyz), identical to the verified Frankencoin ZCHF pattern. Ownerless, immutable hub confirmed on-chain.

controls.label: JUICE pool-share holder veto governance
controls.capDescription: Qualified JUICE pool-share holders (time-weighted votes) can veto proposed minters/positions during the application period; no admin key can alter the system unilaterally.
controls.evidence: Frankencoin-style veto governance: the ownerless contract design (confirmed on-chain) requires pool-share holder veto to accept new minters; no admin key.

review.evidence: At Citrea block 8542294: owner() reverts; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x00; implementation slot = 0x00; mint() reverts NotMinter() (custom error 0xf8d2906c, confirmed via openchain.xyz). Contract has bytecode and is non-proxied/non-upgradeable. Mint authority is fully gated by the Frankencoin-style minter registry — no owner, no proxy admin, no EOA mint path.
